description: High Chipping Efficiency – The BOSCH GSH 500 max delivers 7.8 J of impact energy and 2,900 bpm for superior demolition output, making it ideal for heavy-duty concrete removal. Enhanced Durability – This demolition hammer features a grease sealing ring and improved dust cap, protecting internal components and ensuring longer life in harsh jobsite conditions. Ergonomic Handling – The BOSCH professional tool is designed with a Vario Lock system for 12 chisel positions and a lock-on button, providing comfort and control during extended demolition work. Reliable Performance – Powered by a robust 1,100 W motor, this BOSCH hammer machine with SDS max is built for consistent, high-impact performance across demanding applications. Jobsite-Ready Design – Comes with an auxiliary handle, pointed chisel (280 mm), and carrying case, making this tool a complete and portable demolition solution.
